data.name: Rawsan
data.gender_notes: Rawsan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is rare and delicate in her beauty and actions. The name Rawsan carries the meaning “Graceful, Rare, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rawsan usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, rare, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a woman who embodies the grace and rarity of Allah's creation
data.etymology: Rawsan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Rare, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rawsan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رَوْسَن
in_arabic.long_meaning: رَوْسَن اسم مشتق از رَوْسَنَةٌ به معنی روشن، چمکدار، نورانی، تابناک است. این نام از ریشه 'ر-و-س' مشتق شده که در قرآن کریم نیز به کار رفته است. رَوْسَن نمادی از نور و راهنمایی است.

in_urdu.name: راوسان
in_urdu.long_meaning: راوسان ایک مشتق نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے 'رَوْسَنَةٌ' سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے روشن، چمکدار، نورانی، تابناک۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی 'ر-و-س' جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا اسلامی روایات میں اہم مقام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रौसन
in_hindi.long_meaning: रौसन एक व्युत्पन्न नाम है जो 'रौसनَةٌ' से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है रोशन, चमकदार, नूरानी, ताबाक। यह नाम 'र-व-स' मूल से निकला है, जिसका कुरआन में भी उल्लेख है। रौसन प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: راوسن
in_pashto.long_meaning: راوسن دى يو مشتق نوم چې 'رَوْسَنَةٌ' څخه اخيستل شوى دى. دا نوم د 'ر-و-س' ريښې څخه جوړ شوى دى، چې په قرآن کريم کې يې ذکر شوى دى. راوسن د روښنۍ او لارښودۍ نښه ده.

in_english.name: Rawsan
in_english.long_meaning: Rawsan is a derived name from 'Rawsanah', meaning brilliant, shining, luminous, radiant. It originates from the Arabic root 'r-w-s', which is mentioned in the Quran. Rawsan symbolizes light and guidance, reflecting positive attributes such as illumination and spiritual insight.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rawsan reflects the high value placed on beauty, grace, and refined manners in Islamic culture. It suggests a person who embodies these qualities, making her a source of inspiration and admiration. Additionally, the name may evoke feelings of rarity, uniqueness, and exclusivity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rawsan can serve as a reminder to strive for inner and external beauty in accordance with Islamic values. It can encourage us to be mindful of our actions, speech, and appearance as opportunities to bring joy and positivity to ourselves and those around us. Ultimately, the name invites us to cultivate a character that is not only rare and delicate, but also noble and admirable in the eyes of Allah SWT.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Graceful, Rare, Delicate" symbolizes She who is rare and delicate in her beauty and actions. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rawsan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of graceful, rare, delicate.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Al-Masudi, Muruj Al-Dhahab wa Ma'adin Al-Jawhid (The Meadows of Gold and the Mines of Gems), Chapter XIII, The Cities of Egypt., p. 364
historical_references.context: Al-Masudi describes Rawsan as a city of Egypt, and mentions the presence of a famous mosque there, the Great Mosque of Rawsan.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Battuta, Travels in Asia and Africa, Chapter XVI, Description of Egypt, p. 317 The name Rawsan carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Battuta visited Rawsan during his travels and described it as a large and prosperous city, famous for its sugar industry and its market for sugar, known as the 'Sugar Market'.
